name: Inverse Finance
rootCause: According to BlockSec Phalcon’s monitoring, its system detected a suspicious transaction targeting an Inverse Finance contract on Ethereum several hours ago, resulting in a loss of approximately $240,000. The incident appears to involve DOLA price manipulation, which forced multiple users to liquidate their positions.
